Next year's iPhone Pro model is expected to adopt a brand-new all-glass design, coinciding with the 20th anniversary of the iPhone. Today, the latest leaks have detailed Apple's advancements on this innovative model.

Here's the latest news about Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design

We are just a few weeks away from the unveiling of Apple's first foldable phone—the innovative iPhone Ultra. But next year will see another unique new iPhone design make its debut.

Reports suggest Apple is preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro model. The new device is said to feature a larger screen with a quad-curved display that extends to the edges of the body, delivering a visually near-bezel-less effect.

Weibo leaker Fixed Focus Digital posted a new message today, updating on Apple's progress in achieving this distinctive look.

He said Apple has adopted the same glass assembly process as the iPhone Air, but with modifications using more rounded materials.

The post also pointed out improvements in two aspects:

  • Heat dissipation
  • Slimness

It's still too early to confirm Apple's target specifications for thickness and design materials. However, signs so far indicate this new model will take cues from the iPhone Air and Ultra, but won't prioritise slimness as those two devices do.

Based on these latest updates, there's a chance we'll see some of the design innovations from the iPhone Air and Ultra on this device, while still delivering the performance and battery life that Pro users expect.

Pro users don't want slimness to be the top priority. But if Apple can deliver a near-identical experience on a moderately thinner model, combined with a unique all-glass aesthetic, it should be very appealing.

How interested are you in the rumoured iPhone Pro 20 model coming next year? Let us know in the comments.
